originalTitle: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today | Live: US stock futures ease as Big Tech earnings rekindle AI spending worries, oil jumps
simplifiedContent: The US stock market is expecting a slower start today because of concerns about how much money big technology companies are spending on artificial intelligence (AI). This worry came up again after some of these large tech companies recently shared their earnings. At the same time, the price of oil has gone up. These developments are important because they can affect the overall direction of the stock market. The changes in the stock market, oil prices, and tech company spending can impact the investments of people who have money in the stock market.

originalTitle: Motilal Oswal Q1 Results: Net profit rises 10% YoY to Rs 1,273 crore; revenue climbs 25%
simplifiedContent: Motilal Oswal Financial Services, a financial company, recently released its quarterly results. The company's net profit (or total earnings) increased by 10% compared to the same time last year, reaching Rs 1,273 crore. This growth was driven by strong performance in its asset management and wealth management businesses. The company's revenue also grew by 25%, and it now manages assets worth over Rs 2.12 lakh crore. This matters because it shows that the company is performing well and growing its business, which could be a positive sign for investors.

originalTitle: Infosys ADRs fall over 4% as Q1 revenue guidance cut overshadows profit growth
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening with Infosys: the company's stock price (called ADRs) dropped by more than 4% after they announced their quarterly results. Even though Infosys made more profit and had higher revenue than before, they also said they don't think they'll grow as much as they thought they would this year. This is because some of their clients are being cautious with their spending on technology, which could affect Infosys' business. As a result, investors are worried and selling their shares, causing the stock price to fall. This matters because it shows that investors are paying attention to the company's future prospects, not just its current profits.

originalTitle: Oil price soars close to $100/barrel on fresh Mideast attacks, fears over war widening
simplifiedContent: The price of oil has gone up a lot, almost reaching $100 per barrel. This happened because of new attacks in the Middle East, where a group called the Houthi rebels, supported by Tehran, targeted ships in the Red Sea. This is causing concerns that the conflict in the Middle East might spread, which is making investors nervous and driving up the price of oil. As a result, the main oil contract, called Brent North Sea, is nearing $100 per barrel. This matters because higher oil prices can affect the overall economy and potentially impact the stocks of companies that rely on oil.

originalTitle: Infosys Q1 Results: Attrition rate improves to 13%; headcount slips sequentially
simplifiedContent: Infosys, a big tech company, just released its quarterly earnings report. The company said that fewer employees are leaving on their own, with the rate of people quitting decreasing to 13% from 14.4% last year. The total number of employees at Infosys went down slightly from the previous quarter, but is still higher than it was a year ago. This matters because it shows that Infosys is having some success in keeping its workers, which can help the company do better in the long run. Overall, the company's workforce now has 328,062 employees.

originalTitle: Infosys Q1 results: Profit up 12% YoY; announces new CEO designate; key takeaways of June-quarter earnings
simplifiedContent: Infosys, a big technology company, just released its quarterly earnings report. The company's profit increased by 12.3% compared to the same time last year, but decreased by 8.6% from the previous quarter, reaching ₹7,769 crore. Its revenue, which is the amount of money the company made from its main business, grew 14% from last year and 3.9% from the previous quarter, to ₹48,211 crore. The company also announced that it has chosen a new CEO, which is an important leadership change. This report is significant because it shows how the company is performing financially and who will be leading it in the future.
